text: Reputation and Gossip in Game Theory states the baseline proposition that past behavior may guide future behavior. Kaal's source-bound claim adds an important scope condition: in economic networks where real money and sockpuppet creation are present, historical good behavior cannot be assumed to prove future good behavior. The source establishes the baseline signal, while Kaal's claim qualifies when that signal is unsafe to treat as proof.
